notes: Card: ' Mary' (Quran), ' sea' (Jesus rebuked the winds), ' earth', ' dust' (Quranic creation), ' Muhammad'. Probe: 'created you from dust' 0.57, 'rebuked the winds and the sea' 0.42, earth/water/fire/air 0.20, Muhammad 0.17, but 'Mary, the mother of Jesus' only 0.02; secular sea/dust/Mary 0.02-0.04. So the test drops the names and keeps the nature nouns.
